descriptions: PUSH - T1 - Have LR - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
PUSH.W - T2 - <registers> contains more than one register - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7
POP - T1 - Have PC - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
POP.W - T2 - <registers> contains more than one register - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7
CMP - (immediate) T1 - None - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
CMP.W - (immediate) T2 - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7
CMP - (register) T1 - <Rn> and <Rm> both from R0-R7 - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
CMP - (register) T2 - <Rn> and <Rm> not both from R0-R7 - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
CMP.W - (register) T3 - None - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7
BNE;BEQ;BCS;BHS;BCC;BLO;BMI;BPL;BVS;BVC;BHI;BLS;BGE;BLT;BGT;BLE - T1 - Not permitted in IT block. - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
BNE.W;BEQ.W;BCS.W;BHS.W;BCC.W;BLO.W;BMI.W;BPL.W;BVS.W;BVC.W;BHI.W;BLS.W;BGE.W;BLT.W;BGT.W;BLE.W - T3 - Not permitted in IT block. - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7
BL - T1 - Branch with Link calls a subroutine at a PC-relative address.
MOV - T1 - Move (immediate) writes an immediate value to the destination register. It can optionally update the condition flags based on the value. - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
MOV - T2 - Move (immediate) writes an immediate value to the destination register. - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7
MOV - T3 - Move (immediate) writes an immediate value to the destination register. - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7

MOV - T1 - Move (register) copies a value from a register to the destination register. It can optionally update the condition flags based on the value. - Variant: ARMv6*, ARMv7 if <Rd> and <Rm> both from R0-R7 ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7 otherwise
MOV - T2 - Move (register) copies a value from a register to the destination register. - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
MOV - T3 - Move (register) copies a value from a register to the destination register. - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7

STR - T1 - Store Register (register) calculates an address from a base register value and an offset register value, stores a word from a register to memory. The offset register value can optionally be shifted. - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
STR - T2 - Store Register (register) calculates an address from a base register value and an offset register value, stores a word from a register to memory. - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7

STR - T1 - Store Register (immediate) calculates an address from a base register value and an immediate offset, and stores a word from a register to memory. It can use offset, post-indexed, or pre-indexed addressing.  - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
STR - T2 - Store Register (immediate) calculates an address from a base register value and an immediate offset, and stores a word from a register to memory. - Variant: ARMv4T, ARMv5T*, ARMv6*, ARMv7
STR - T3 - Store Register (immediate) calculates an address from a base register value and an immediate offset, and stores a word from a register to memory. - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7
STR - T4 - Store Register (immediate) calculates an address from a base register value and an immediate offset, and stores a word from a register to memory. - Variant: ARMv6T2, ARMv7
